# Homebrew formulae for a macOS host, grouped like env/apt-packages.txt.
# macOS ships one artefact: YOFO Review (sections base + desktop-shell; its
# OpenCV / HDF5 come from Conan, statically — macos-review-core preset,
# docs/howto/macos-build.md). The backend / frontend sections serve local
# development of the Qt-free core and the Python tools from Homebrew.
# section: base
cmake
ninja
pkgconf
git
python@3.12
sevenzip

# section: backend
opencv
hdf5
spdlog
fmt
nlohmann-json
sqlite
openssl@3

# section: frontend
qt

# section: desktop-shell
node@22
rustup
